summary: The StudentQualifications component is a user control for managing student qualifications within a web application. It provides functionalities for viewing, editing, inserting, and deleting student qualifications using a grid interface with associated data sources.
purpose: To facilitate the management of student qualifications within the application by providing a user-friendly interface for interacting with qualification data.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Identifies the student for whom the qualifications are being managed.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Represents the current user session for maintaining session-specific data.

fields.name: qualificationCodeID
fields.description: The code identifier for the qualification, selected from a dropdown list.

fields.name: authorityCodeID
fields.description: The code identifier for the authority granting the qualification, selected from a dropdown list.

fields.name: countryCodeID
fields.description: The code identifier for the country of the qualification, selected from a dropdown list.

actors.name: User
actors.description: Interacts with the system to manage student qualifications.

workflows.name: Manage Student Qualifications
steps: Display existing qualifications in a grid.
Allow editing of qualifications if the screen is editable.
Provide options to add new qualifications.
Handle deletion of qualifications through a command interface.
Redirect after adding or updating a qualification.

business_rules: The user session must exist for qualification data operations to proceed.
The grid must be editable for the user to add or edit qualifications.

validations.action: Prevents insertion or update if the page is not valid.

conditions.action: Determines whether the add and edit buttons are visible.
Determines if the edit and delete buttons are enabled.

system_behavior: Redirects the user after inserting or updating an item.
Disables edit fields if the screen is not editable.
dependencies: HSPnetSession to maintain user session details across operations.
exceptions: Cancel data operations if Page.IsValid is false.
